headline: U.S. Orders IDF to Prepare for Iran Campaign Amid Regional Force Buildup
subheadline: Israeli strike near Shifa Hospital kills one, injures several, while Houthis claim attacks on Saudi pipelines and Yanbu oil facility.
lede: U.S. Central Command has ordered the IDF to ready for a possible renewed military campaign in Iran, citing a buildup of roughly 200 tanker aircraft and three carriers. Israeli forces struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, eliminating Hamas commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and killing six with over twenty wounded. Iranian air defenses are active across six provinces, with missile launches, UAV operations, and anti‑aircraft fire reported. Houthi forces claim attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and Riyadh pushes the EU toward a terrorist designation.

sections.title: Ukraine Front: Russian Drone and Missile Barrage
sections.body: On 12 November 2026 Russia launched Shahed-type UAVs and reactive UAVs from Orel, Bryansk, and Millerovo. Two ballistic missiles struck the northern bridge in Kyiv, and a drone carrying an anti‑personnel shrapnel warhead fell on a residential street. President Zelensky reported systematic Starshield speed limitations to 161 km/h along the entire front line, degrading Ukrainian C4ISR. Geran‑5 missiles hit Vinnytsia city and the Rivne region, while three Banderaol cruise missiles were fired from the Mykolaiv region toward Odesa.

sections.title: Iran Campaign Prep and Regional Air Defense Surge
sections.body: U.S. Central Command has warned the IDF and Gulf states to prepare for a renewed Iranian campaign amid a buildup of roughly 200 tanker aircraft and three carriers. Israeli forces struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, killing Hamas commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and six others with over twenty wounded. Iranian air defenses are active across Khuzestan, Kurdistan, West Azerbaijan, and Hormozgan, with missile launches, UAV operations, and anti‑aircraft fire reported. Houthi forces claim attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure, specifically the East‑West pipeline and Yanbu oil facility, while Riyadh seeks EU terrorist designation without full member support.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The combined U.S. and Israeli pressure on Iran, coupled with Iranian air defense activation, signals a heightened regional escalation. Simultaneously, Russia's sustained missile and drone barrage in Ukraine degrades Ukrainian C4ISR, while Houthi claims on Saudi infrastructure add a new front of cross‑border aggression.
